record.confidence_note: every value is quoted from the vendor's pricing, workers, demo, getting-started and privacy pages; no sign-up was made, so the terms of the FOSS plan, the card requirement and any per-job time cap are unverified

free_tier.stated: no free hosted compute beyond a trial: the FOSS plan is free with your own workers, hosted workers are billed at USD 0.33 an hour even on it, and new users get a 14-day trial on the demo system, after which builds stop. The demo needs no signup and builds the newest 3 commits of a repository
free_tier.notes: the hosted plan is USD 37 a month per developer plus USD 0.33 per worker-hour; a developer is a person who pushes at least 3 commits to private repositories in a month

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the hosted worker and pricing pages state no per-job time limit

retention.stated: build logs are kept 60 days; build metadata 90 days; cached artefacts 90 days

record.interface_detail: a GitHub App, a GitLab or a Codeberg webhook runs CI for every repository that has a flake.nix, with no in-repo configuration required; results come back as commit statuses
record.tooling: a flake.nix in the repository; the NixCI GitHub App, or a GitLab or Codeberg integration; hosted workers are 16 vCPU, 64 GiB RAM, 1 TB disk, x86_64-linux machines at Hetzner
record.chaining: the hosted workers run x86_64-linux Nix builds, tests and deployments from a flake; a GitHub Actions job on a public repository comes first, and the user's own workers come last

limits.value: 14-day trial on the demo system; builds stop after it ends unless the account is upgraded
hosted workers billed at USD 0.3342 an hour per second of job execution, on every plan
build logs 60 days; build metadata and cached artefacts 90 days

record.limits_note: the demo runs only the newest 3 commits of a repository
record.binding_note: hosted compute is paid by the second on every plan and the only free hosted use is the 14-day trial, so no free hosted allowance remains after it

identity_cost.detail: sign-in is through a GitHub, GitLab or Codeberg account, held by installing the NixCI GitHub App on the repositories or by the equivalent GitLab or Codeberg webhook; the demo states that no signup or payment details are required. Beyond the trial the account takes a Subscribe step, which is behind a login wall, so unverified: behind a sign-up whether that step asks for a card. No phone number appears anywhere in the sign-up path

record.reliability_note: unverified: the vendor publishes no uptime figure or status page that was read

record.notes: A hosted Nix CI exists with no free hosted allowance: the FOSS plan is free only when the user supplies the workers, and hosted worker time is paid by the second, so the offer is trial-only. Hosted runners of this topic come first. Last resort: the user's own workers, which NixCI offers to any subscriber on request. Sign-up is a GitHub, GitLab or Codeberg account through the forge App, and beyond the trial a Subscribe step follows; unverified: behind a sign-up whether that step asks for a card, so the card flag is left unknown rather than set to no.
